description: Contra is reshaped by Veronica Mann’s corporate takeover while Oz, Cameron, Cash, Molly and the rest of the team keep pulling jobs and trying to regain control of the company.

s02e01.description: Cameron, Cash and Melanie discover Oz is being forced to sell Contra to a conglomerate led by Veronica Mann, whose arrival overturns the office.

s02e02.description: Oz’s sale of Contra comes to a head when Veronica reveals plans to take the company in a radically different direction.

s02e03.description: When Veronica rejects Contra’s annual job protecting a diamond-encrusted bra, the team secretly takes the assignment anyway.

s02e04.description: The team hunts a computer hacker while Veronica unexpectedly recruits a teenage prodigy, and Cameron and Melanie endure an awkward stakeout.

s02e05.description: Molly questions whether Contra’s legendary salesman Mr. Jones even exists, forcing Oz to prove the story while Veronica tries to win over the office.

s02e06.description: Oz turns to Cash for help discouraging Molly after realizing that she has developed a crush on him.

s02e07.description: Oz loses an account to a former protégé and is forced to reveal a costly secret while Cameron tries to break Cash’s online-auction habit.

s02e08.description: Oz, Cash and Molly go treasure hunting while Veronica recruits Cameron to accompany her to a supposed leadership conference.

s02e09.description: The team plans a sham wedding to keep Molly from being deported, while Oz discovers that he is still legally married to his ex-wife Amy.

s02e10.description: Veronica fears a corporate rival is taking control of Contra’s future, while Cameron tries to preserve the appearance of his fake marriage to Molly.

s02e11.description: A girls’ night out and a missing prized possession force Contra’s men and women to combine efforts the morning after.

s02e12.description: Contra competes against an old enemy for bragging rights while Cameron’s sham marriage is complicated by the return of Melanie.

s02e13.description: The team chases a major job that could let Oz buy Contra back while paying elaborate tribute to a beloved science-fiction franchise.
